column3: camera.ts:18 is the only declaration (rg 'interface Camera\b'), but not every post-process reads it: post-process/bloom.ts, blur.ts, black-and-white.ts, chromatic-aberration.ts, anaglyph.ts do not mention camera at all

not every interface built on the contract: BankedFreeCamera (banked-free-camera.ts:20, extends FreeCamera) is a fourth camera kind of this directory and is missed, because the pattern only matches direct 'extends Camera'

free-camera.ts:39 passes the shared Vec3Up constant (math/vec3-up.ts); banked-free-camera.ts:43-44 passes a mutable ObservableVec3 that marks the matrix dirty; rg '_createFreeCamera' finds no other caller
camera.ts:236-239 is the definition (camera.ts also holds the Camera contract at :18); viewport.ts:2 is a bare re-export; the third hit, world-to-screen.ts:91, is only a doc mention

a multi-line import search over src/camera finds every other scene/animation/picking import is 'import type'; createWorldMatrixState in arc-rotate.ts:6, free-camera.ts:6, geospatial-camera.ts:5 (banked uses _markLocalMatrixDirty plus _createFreeCamera); runFrameInterpolation in arc-rotate-interpolate.ts:193; createPickingRay used at geospatial-camera-controls.ts:131

all 7 files branch on _rightHanded in code (e.g. camera.ts:139, arc-rotate-controls.ts:438, geospatial-camera.ts:105); engine/coordinate-system.ts:2-8 says it is fixed at build time and resolved through the package 'imports' map, never by path

there are four camera factories but only three copies: createBankedFreeCamera gets the flip through _createFreeCamera (free-camera.ts:61); and a new camera kind does not have to copy it, since XrCamera (xr/xr-camera.ts) has no such loop and handles handedness in copyXrRigidMatrixToWorld

arc-rotate.ts:142-144, free-camera.ts:86-88, geospatial-camera.ts:293-295 allocate their caches via allocateMat4; math/_matrix-allocator.ts:28-30,42-44 has one module-level _allocate, which engine/engine.ts:443-445 switches to F64 when useHpm is set
the matched line 10 says only 'process-global'; lines 11-12 add that pages mixing HPM and non-HPM engines are unsupported and the second engine inherits the first's precision

write-perspective-mat4-lh-into-buffer.ts:5 and write-ortho-off-center-mat4-lh-into-buffer.ts:4-5 say near->1, far->0, and the coefficients check out (perspective out[10]=-n/(f-n), out[14]=fn/(f-n); ortho out[10]=-1/(f-n), out[14]=f/(f-n)); camera.ts:209 and orthographic.ts:126 call them; the perspective file has its opening doc line twice (lines 3-4)
a wider search for any quoted '../camera/' path (which includes dynamic imports) returns the same 57 files; no file in src/camera uses '../camera/'; index.ts:201ff uses './camera/'
xr/xr-camera.ts is among the 12 but does not gate any GPU upload on the key: it uses it at xr-camera.ts:116 to pre-stamp _projVer for its injected projection

scene/parentable.ts:16-17 is on IWorldMatrixProvider.worldMatrixVersion; camera.ts:178-183 says _cameraChangeKey sums it with _projRev (:196) and that a custom Camera must keep it non-decreasing or a change can be missed (a drop can cancel a _projRev rise)

xr-camera.ts:103-117 writes _projCache, then sets _projVer=_cameraChangeKey(cam) and _projAspect, so camera.ts:202-203 returns the cache unchanged; rg '_projVer\s*=' finds no other writer outside camera.ts
scene-core.ts:337 is in syncCameraFloatingOrigin, called from _update at :387 and :391; it is the only assignment in src; camera.ts:119-122 zeroes cx/cy/cz so v[12..14] become 0

incomplete: a camera also becomes active through scene.camera = cam in createDefaultCamera (scene/scene-camera.ts:54) and stops being active in removeFromScene (scene/scene-remove.ts:43, :93); the 'ctx.camera' pattern misses these

camera.ts:151-160 (projector seam folds away unless set) is set only by enableOrthographicCamera (orthographic.ts:138); arc-rotate-controls.ts:84-89 is set only by enableArcRotateKeyboardControls (arc-rotate-keyboard-controls.ts:164-166, 'pointer-only bundles remove all keyboard state')

_arcRotateKeyboardFactory is read only at arc-rotate-controls.ts:262, once per attachControl call (line 88 is the only write); later uses go through keyboardAttachment (:432, :527), so an attach made before the enable call gets undefined and its keyboard option is dropped
loader-gltf/gltf-feature-camera.ts:126-129: the dynamic import sits inside 'if (def.type === "orthographic")'

not every callback: interpolateArcRotateCamera (arc-rotate-interpolate.ts:193) also registers one through runFrameInterpolation, which pushes its driver onto scene._beforeRender (animation/frame-interpolation.ts:103)

arc-rotate-controls.ts:495-497 and free-camera-controls.ts:160-162 / configurable-free-camera-controls.ts:157-159 push only 'if (scene)'; keyboard is polled only inside those hooks (arc-rotate-controls.ts:432; free update :80-97); setCameraLimits does 'void scene' at :147

arc-rotate-controls.ts:215-235 documents it; disposeScene's cleanup (scene-core.ts:625-647) empties _beforeRender etc. but never touches canvas listeners; onSceneDispose (scene/scene-change.ts:199) adds the callback to scene._disposables
geospatial-camera-controls.ts:53 has a required scene and pushes at :760 with no guard; attachControl, attachFreeControl and attachConfigurableFreeControl all take 'scene?:'

geospatial-camera-fly.ts:76 cancels any earlier fly, :142 installs finish and :136-138 clears it; geospatial-camera-controls.ts:478-482 calls it when the pan/rotation/zoom accumulators (keyboard included, via pollKeyboard) are non-zero
does not differ per factory: createBankedFreeCamera goes through _createFreeCamera and gets the same farPlane 10000 as createFreeCamera (free-camera.ts:79)
arc-rotate.ts:124 0.1 against free-camera.ts:78 1 and geospatial-camera.ts:283 1; banked gets free's value through _createFreeCamera

orthographic.ts:146-156 is disableOrthographicCamera; the ortho writer sets [12],[13],[15] to non-zero values while the perspective writer writes only 0,5,10,11,14 (write-perspective-...:10-14), so exactly these three would carry over

arc-rotate.ts:74 declares it; :160-172 is the shared defineProperty setter for alpha/beta/radius that calls it; arc-rotate-controls.ts:173 installs it and :177-178 (setCameraLimits' disposer) clears it; no writer outside src/camera
arc-rotate-controls.ts:146-147: the 'void scene' statement is the first line of setCameraLimits, and the function uses scene nowhere else
arc-rotate-controls.ts:441-442 are inside applyInertia (:431) and take no limit fields; it runs only on frames where an alpha/beta inertial offset is non-zero (:436)

'unlike the free-camera update' is wrong: free-camera-controls.ts:133-140 (and configurable :124-131) also decay by camera.inertia once per frame regardless of deltaMs; deltaMs is used only for moveSpeed

arc-rotate-interpolate.ts:133-143 throws when alpha/beta/radius/target differ from the last write; runFrameInterpolation catches it and rejects (frame-interpolation.ts step catch); a newer interpolation's first step writes the pose (:153-156) and so trips the check (doc :63-67); it compares only those pose fields, so movement through a parent goes unseen

geospatial-camera-fly.ts:70-72 doc; the Promise has only resolve (:97), and finish() (:131-140), which is also _cancelFly, calls resolve(); arc-rotate interpolation rejects instead (arc-rotate-interpolate.ts:74-76, :143)

scene-core.ts:388 is a live for-of; frame-interpolation.ts:60-63 warns that splicing skips the next callback; geospatial-camera-fly.ts:126-127 calls finish() from the driver, which splices at :134 (also reachable from the controls' tick at controls:481); this is a real bug, as the next _beforeRender callback is skipped for that frame
geospatial-camera.ts:310-315: the getter returns the internal 'center' object and only the setter calls applyOrientation; a field write changes center but recomputes nothing and marks nothing dirty

limits are read only inside applyOrientation (geospatial-camera.ts:243-245) and by control zoom code before it calls orientation; caveat: applyOrientation closes over the original limits object, so assigning a new object to camera.limits never reaches the camera's own clamp
geospatial-camera.ts:14 +Z, used for the basis (:105) and the pole clamp (:189, sinLat=center.z/mag), while engine world up is +Y (math/vec3-up.ts, arc-rotate.ts:101)

free-camera-controls.ts:125-130 and configurable :118-130 set target = position + unit dir(_yaw,_pitch) whenever there is movement or rotation; _yaw/_pitch are set only at creation (free-camera.ts:71-72) and by these controls, so a hand-written target is lost; 'mouse move' means a drag (pointermove counts only while isDragging), and this needs a scene

world-to-screen.ts:52-77 validateOptions, called at :95 by projectWorldToScreenToRef, which projectWorldToScreen wraps (:149-150); projectPointToViewportToRef (:44-50) validates nothing and its doc (:41-42) allows zero-sized viewports; it also throws when only one of cssWidth/cssHeight is given
